summary: Mynd.ai, Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a change to its ADS ratio from one ADS representing ten ordinary shares to one ADS representing 75 ordinary shares, equivalent to a one-for-7.5 reverse ADS split, effective on or about December 7, 2026, subject to depositary Citibank procedures. ADSs continue trading on NYSE American under MYND with new CUSIP 628988206; ordinary shares are unaffected and no shares are cancelled. Fractional new ADSs are aggregated and sold with net proceeds distributed. This is a routine ratio adjustment, not a special situation; watch post-split liquidity and any delisting-compliance motive.
